title: Voice Dictation & Hands-Free Audio Entry
details: Integrate speech-to-text audio input for quick logging of daily vitals, symptoms, and meal entries without typing.

title: Grocery Receipt & Pantry Photo OCR Scanning
details: Multimodal computer vision to parse grocery store receipts or shelf photos to automatically populate pantry ingredients and quantities.

title: Clinical Encounter Notes & Narrative Symptom Logs
details: Support freeform clinical encounter notes, doctor visit transcripts, and narrative symptom journals alongside structured numerical logs.

title: Apple Health & HealthKit Hardware Sync Integration
details: Import data from Apple Health, Garmin, and Bluetooth smart scales/cuffs directly into local SQLite storage.
